turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: About two hours ago I suddenly started having abdominal cramps, along with nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. I had reheated food from the afternoon about an hour before it began.
Are you having any fevers, or have you
“No, I don’t have a fever. I also haven’t noticed any blood in my stool.”
What kind of food did you reheat and eat before the symptoms started?
Patient: It was reheated leftover food from the dorm cafeteria—mostly rice and some meat dish. It smelled a bit reheated but I didn’t notice anything unusual at the time.
Are you experiencing any other symptoms like dizziness, lightheaded
“No, I’m not feeling dizzy or lightheaded—mostly it’s the cramping with the nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. I’d say it came on pretty quickly after the meal and hasn’t really let up.”
